01

We find where your week disappears

We map out the whole business, top to bottom — every job that gets repeated, everything that gets done twice, everywhere the work slows down. You get it back written out, with the time and money attached to each one.

Week 1
02

We build the context

This is the part everyone skips, and it's why most people's AI gives useless answers. We teach it your business — how you quote, how you talk to customers, the way you like things done. Everything we build after this sits on top of it.
